1502.author: yuanzhou75
1502.body:
## What happens

Four rules in `apps/desktop/src/styles/design.css` draw secondary text at `#808080`, `#8c8c8c` and `#a6a6a6`. All of it is normal-size text — 11 px, 12 px, 12.5 px — so WCAG 2.1 AA applies at **4.5:1** (SC 1.4.3; the large-text exemption starts at 18 pt, or 14 pt bold). Measured against the surfaces they actually render on, every one is below the floor, and two of them are below 3:1:

| rule | colour | size | surface it is drawn on | contrast |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.settings-field-hint` | `#808080` | 12.5 px | `#fff` — the settings panel (`.config-panel` and `.config-backdrop` are `#fff`; `.settings-main` is `#fff`) | **3.95:1** |
| the same rule inside `.settings-ability-option.is-selected` | `#808080` | 12.5 px | `#f4f8ff` (`--primary-softer`) | **3.71:1** |
| `.session-flyout-desc` | `#8c8c8c` | 12 px | `#fff` — `.session-menu-flyout` is `#fff` | **3.36:1** |
| the same rule while its row is hovered | `#8c8c8c` | 12 px | `#f5f5f5` — `.session-flyout-row:hover` | **3.08:1** |
| `.session-flyout-note` (added for #1330, same colour) | `#8c8c8c` | 12 px | `#fff` | **3.36:1** |
| `.expert-note` | `#8c8c8c` | 12 px | `#fff` — the 专家 flyout | **3.36:1** |
| `.doc-tab-hint` | `#a6a6a6` | 11 px | `#f0f0f0` (`--surface-sunk`, the workspace panel) or `#fff` inside a `.workspace-section` | **2.14:1 / 2.43:1** |

Ratios are WCAG 2.1 relative luminance against the background named in the same row.

The two darkest cases are worth naming on their own: `#a6a6a6` on `#f0f0f0` is **2.14:1**, and `#8c8c8c` on the hover row is **3.08:1** — the second one only appears while the pointer is over the row the reader is reading, which is exactly when they need it.

## These are user-visible text, not decoration

- `.settings-field-hint` carries the sentence under a settings field: the skill-name rule (`TEXT.settings.skills.nameHint`, and `nameInvalid` in the same element), the specialist instructions hint and the capability hint (`TEXT.settings.system.specialists.instructionsHint`, `capabilitiesHint`) — `views/settings/SkillForm.tsx`, `views/settings/system/SpecialistForm.tsx`. Only the `is-error` variant switches to `--danger`, and that one is not part of this report.
- `.expert-note` carries the flyout's own status: `TEXT.composer.expertsLoading` (“正在读取专家…”) and `TEXT.composer.expertsEmpty` (“没有匹配的专家。”) — `views/Composer.tsx`.
- `.session-flyout-desc` carries the line that explains what each choice does, under the label of every row of 审查档位, 请求批准 and 会话设置.
- `.doc-tab-hint` carries the folder that tells two same-named documents apart in the tab strip — `views/WorkspacePanel.tsx`.

None of them is an icon, a placeholder, a disabled control or decorative text, so none of them is exempt.

## Where it comes from

`apps/desktop/src/styles/design.css` at `main` `d9f5a3da`:

- `:2208` `.session-flyout-desc { color: #8c8c8c; font-size: 12px; … }`
- `:2216` `.session-flyout-note { color: #8c8c8c; font-size: 12px; … }`
- `:2442` `.expert-note { color: #8c8c8c; font-size: 12px; … }`
- `:2993` `.doc-tab-hint { color: #a6a6a6; font-size: 11px; … }`
- `:4225` `.settings-field-hint { color: #808080; font-size: 12.5px; … }`

Two of the three colours are already tokens, so the fix is at token level rather than per selector: `apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css:36` `--text-faint: #8c8c8c`, `:35` `--muted-light: #a6a6a6`; `#808080` is written literally. The surfaces in the table are `--surface: #ffffff` (`:20`), `--surface-sunk: #f0f0f0` (`:24`), `--surface-hover: #ededed` (`:23`), `--primary-softer: #f4f8ff` (`:41`), and `.session-flyout-row:hover { background: #f5f5f5 }` (`:2177`).

## Suggested fix

Move all three to one secondary-text value that clears 4.5:1 on the worst surface in the table:

| candidate | on `#fff` | on `#f5f5f5` | on `#f0f0f0` | on `#f4f8ff` | on `#ededed` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `#666666` | 5.74 | 5.27 | 5.04 | 5.39 | 4.90 |
| `#777777` (today's `--muted`) | 4.48 | 4.11 | 3.93 | 4.20 | 3.83 |

`#666666` is the value already agreed for the desktop sidebar hints in #1486, which is the same defect on a different surface; using it here as well keeps one secondary colour across the desktop instead of a third shade. Note that `--muted` (`#777777`) does **not** clear the floor on the darker surfaces, so it cannot simply be reused.

## Related

#1486 reports the same problem for the sidebar and the landing surface. This report is the settings, flyout and document-tab half of it; the two do not overlap.

## Environment

- Windows 11, desktop renderer (React in Chromium), zh-CN and en.
- Colour values, surfaces and sizes read from `apps/desktop/src/styles` at `main` `d9f5a3da8c281829d6791efbbe3ce9392bf936b6`; ratios computed with the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance formula.
- No backend, no data and no behaviour involved: this is a stylesheet and token change.
1502.title: [Bug]: Desktop settings, flyout and document-tab hint text misses WCAG AA (2.14:1 – 3.95:1)
